Core Subsystems

Short, precise host capabilities without artificial boundaries.

01

Root Host Filesystem

Direct read and write across your physical drives without sandbox restrictions. Move, edit, batch upload, and scaffold folders directly on the host machine.

02

Format Management Hub

Recursively scans target folders like Documents to categorize Presentations (.pptx), PDFs, Spreadsheets, and Code. 1-click Auto-Organize cleans scattered files instantly.

03

Local Ollama Intelligence

Private on-device semantic file search powered by your local GPU (qwen2.5:1.5b). Zero cloud dependencies, zero external data leakage.

04

Dual Shells & Git Automation

Automates the full Git repository lifecycle from branch creation to semantic commits. Paired with a live PowerShell terminal and real-time host CPU and RAM telemetry.
